profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at JPMorgan Chase
profile.summary: I am a highly motivated front-end developer with a complete understanding of software engineering principles and a solid grounding in IT. I specialize in using the latest technol- ogies, including React, Redux, Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, bootstrap and JQuery, to help companies build innovative products and meet critical business goals. Some of my recent projects include Public Earthcam, an application that provides camera networks with live streaming, social sharing, archiving, panoramic capture and recording capabilities. I’ve also built the CC8-EVR control center to manage clients’ network cameras.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Lead a development team for successful project launches
• Converted Angular application code into React applications
• Corrected application bugs and contents by improving functionalities and creating usable React 
   components
• Reinforced live streaming application with RTSP and Web RTC tools
• Implemented user-friendly UI/UX design with page animation and CSS

positions.title: Web Developer & Assistant Manager
positions.description:
• Created Service Map area using Google’s Map API
• Designed a Ticket Management System user interface
• Developed an Enterprise Resource Planning System with data
import/export using JavaScript, Laravel, and MySQL
• Maintained client’s website functionality using JavaScript and
server backup with AWS S3 Glacier

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description:
• Optimizing company’s web page into a mobile friendly design using media queries in CSS3
• Adding web page automatic slide images banner using Javascript, JQuery
• Maintaining website and applications, including contents updates and testing with Github
• Applying Login page with google firebase to store user info and display company’s location with google map API 
• Operating system and management tools for clients such as Samsung, Hansol, and ZT group INC, Installing software
• Constituting network environment, installing server and Ip-phones
• Updating company’s security program fetches and checking system’s status with SQL query

positions.title: Intern Mobile Engineer
positions.description:
- Inspected the mobile problems and software with strong knowledge of  internal structure. 
- Managed over a thousand electronics,  including broken glass, charging port, screen, touch panel.
- Repaired hardware and software, trouble shooting, and  new ESN. 
- Developed working relationship with clients.
